title: weapon.feel.mass — fix the tip-speed / follow-through / continuity failure handed on by W1-11

findings: REPRODUCED at git 5863a06, `node tools/weapons/motion-census.mjs`: 606 clips, tip speed over 1.25x band 43.4% (263 clips), 91 socket pose steps > 1.00 m (E.2 HARD FAIL), arc nonconforming 3.96%, worst whp_hist_bindings/r2 163.34 m/s. Identical to W1-11's figures, so the tree has not moved under the diagnosis.

REFINEMENT OF W1-11's DIAGNOSIS — the violations are TWO populations, not one. Of the 263 tip-speed violations, only 107 have a MEAN active-window speed above the ceiling (i.e. the active window itself is over-driven); 156 peak OUTSIDE the active window, in startup or recovery. calibrateExcursion (swing.js:399) already exists to damp exactly those and is wired in (moveset.js:490). So the second population is a BUG IN THE EXISTING DAMPER, not an absent one.

THE DAMPER BUG, found by reading Clip.phaseAt (clips.js:75). Phase 1.0 is the FIRST active frame (f = startup+1) and phase 2.0 is the FIRST RECOVERY frame (f = startup+active+1); the active window therefore spans phases [1.0, 2 - 1/active]. calibrateExcursion solves `follow` over the frame band [S+A, T]. f = S+A is the LAST ACTIVE frame and the step it measures (S+A-1 -> S+A) lies wholly inside the active window, where dampExcursion changes nothing (it only scales keys with phase > 2, about the phase-2.0 value). So on any clip whose active window is over-speed, that step exceeds declaredMps for EVERY value of follow, the 20-step bisection runs to its floor, and `follow` is set to 0 — the follow-through is deleted to fix a frame it cannot reach. The windup side is NOT affected: its band [1, S+1] pivots on phase 1.0 = frame S+1, and frame S is at phase < 1 so it IS scalable.

THE DAMPER BUG, MEASURED: follow_scale over all 606 clips is BIMODAL — 483 clips at 1.0, 122 clips at exactly 0, one at 0.9. That bimodality is the signature of a solve that either passes on its first try or bisects to the floor; a genuine constraint would give a spread. 99 of the 122 collapsed clips are also tip-speed violators (99/263 = 38% of violators, against 23/343 = 7% of clean clips). This is W1-11's 'recovery COMPLETELY DEAD, tip frozen for 80 consecutive frames, follow_frac 0.407 in the registry but 0.012 achieved' — the profile data was always fine; the damper zeroed it.

SO ONE ROOT CAUSE HAS TWO DISTINCT CODE EXPRESSIONS: (1) calibrateYawGain's objective (measureActiveArc, active window alone) contains no speed term, so the active window's angular rate is unconstrained — 107 clips; (2) calibrateExcursion's follow band is off by two frames, so an over-speed active window silently deletes the follow-through of 122 clips. (2) is a pure code fix that moves no declaration. (1) is the declaration change.

A CLOSED-FORM MODEL OF THE DEFECT, VALIDATED AGAINST THE RIG. peak_tip_speed = K * arc_rad * reach_m * 60 / active_f, with K = 1.5 EXACTLY — the maximum derivative of `smoothstep`, which clips.js:19 uses between every pair of keys, so the blade accelerates from rest at the first active frame, peaks at 1.5x mean mid-window, and returns to rest at the last. Validated on all 606 census clips: measured peak / K*(true active path)*60/active_f is p10 1.01, p50 1.04, p90 1.12. Effective tip radius / declared reach_m is p50 1.03 on wide arcs, so reach_m IS the lever arm by construction (moveset.js solves the blade so max horizontal radius over the active window equals reach_m). The model is predictive, so the declaration arithmetic can be done without the rig.

THE CLASS DECLARATIONS ARE MUTUALLY INCONSISTENT FOR 8 OF 15 CLASSES, at the class row alone (r1.1, before any pose scaling). Max arc a class can sweep inside 1.25x its §E band top, given its own reach_m and r1_active: DGR 91 (declares 70, OK), FST 71 (45 OK), TSW 58 (10 OK), SPR 53 (8 OK), MCE 146 (95 OK), GHM 177 (120 OK), AXE 138 (130 OK), UGS 216 (210 OK) — and CSW 91 (declares 155, 1.70x over), SSW 82 (110, 1.35x), HLB 102 (145, 1.43x), GSW 157 (175, 1.12x), CGS 167 (340, 2.04x), WHP 58 (200, 3.48x). The clean six are exactly the classes the census reports clean. BOW declares NO peak_tip_speed_mps at all, so calibrateExcursion never runs on any bow clip — and BOW's reach_m is 22.00 (arrow RANGE), which build-movesets turns into a 20.56 m blade capsule. Separate defect, recorded not fixed.

BLAST RADIUS OF THE OBVIOUS FIX, AND WHY IT IS NOT LANDABLE AS STATED. If active_f is simply derived from the §E ceiling: 1,478 of 2,689 slots would need MORE active frames, +13,957 active f@60 across the roster, and 478 slots are UNREACHABLE even at the existing active clamp of 32 f@60. 234 of those 478 are shape `spin`. So 'lengthen the active window' is a rewrite of the combat frame data, not a fix.

WHERE THE 360-DEGREE SPINS COME FROM — THE CLAMP RUNS THE WRONG WAY. build-movesets.mjs:630 does `clamp(rawArc, band[0], band[1])` against SHAPE_ARC_BAND, and `spin`'s band is [305,360]. A halberd's art_whirl computes 145 x 1.55 = 225 degrees; the clamp INFLATES it to 305 so it will match the label `spin`. RI-WPN02 M5's bands exist to catch MISLABELLED data ('a weapon labelled thrust that sweeps 140 degrees is mislabelled'); the build tool satisfies M5 by bending the ARC to fit the LABEL instead of the label to fit the arc. That is how 234 near-full revolutions of 2.8-3.8 m weapons got manufactured, at 13-24 active f@60 = 70-160 m/s by arithmetic. whp_hist_bindings/r2 is one of them: roster.json gives it a per-weapon `unq` override to art_whirl (a spin family), 200 x 1.55 = 310 -> 305 after the delta, on a 3.78 m weapon in 11 active f@60. Note build-movesets ALREADY guards this class of mistake for r1.1 ('a weapon's r1.1 may be a different POSE from its class's, but not a different arc BAND') and has no such guard on any other slot.

DETERMINISM BASELINES THAT HOLD AGAINST THESE BYTES (searched reports/ and corpus/90-verdicts/, and read the status files of every piece touched in the last 3 h): (1) reports/w1-09/exemplar/RI-CMB07-exemplar-scenario.json pins FIVE absolute fight trace hashes (2c900087, a78342, 3efc6903, 951390c6, ae9be5f4) — regenerable by tools/harness/cmb-exemplar.mjs; S22 already invalidated this exemplar once by ruling. (2) reports/render/render-probe-baseline.json pins PIXEL-EXACT frame-8 PNG md5s for ssw_garrison_sword / hlb_garrison_bill / cgs_drowned_reaper and records their active_frames (10/14/-); owner W1-RENDER, state complete. (3) reports/W1-10-fingerprint.json, W1-10-measure.json, W1-10-live-census.json (W1-10 rounds, all complete). (4) reports/platform/decoupling.json M6 compares two runs to EACH OTHER (render-rate independence), so it holds no absolute and does not move. (5) reports/determinism-lint.json is a static lint over game/src and holds no trace.
